note: Source reference is a working directory without Git metadata; SHA-256 records the imported files. tests/mock_peer.c is imported from integration/mock_peer.c.

local_adaptations.LeanXRPL/StateTree.lean: Additive appendSorted snapshot builder and transactional checkpoint callback. Existing replay, encoding, authenticated path, and proof definitions are unchanged.
local_adaptations.LeanXRPL/NodeStore.lean: Add generic state view and acquisition-scope persistence declarations. XRPL policy and verification remain in Lean.
local_adaptations.native/store.c: Add generic legacy state views and scoped acquisition metadata/frontiers/counters in one shared payload catalog via node_view.inc and node_scope.inc. Scoped/global counters share flush-before-commit durability; scoped writers allow retained readers during passive WAL checkpointing.
local_adaptations.tools/generate_merkle_certificate.py: Ledger-specific namespaces and case-normalized commitments; hash lemmas evaluate SHA512Fast and transfer results through its proved half_eq theorem to the unchanged KernelMerkle.nodeHash statement. Six bounded parallel hash workers by default; receipts record evaluator and worker count.
local_adaptations.LeanXRPL/Native.lean: Add RIPEMD160 and secp256k1 public-point validation declarations for unsigned Batch input consistency checks; neither primitive enters the pure kernel certificate.
local_adaptations.native/bridge.c: Add generic OpenSSL RIPEMD160 and compressed secp256k1 public-point validation bridges; XRPL account derivation and Batch policy remain in Lean.
